text:
Anya: Quick heads-up — for next week's retarget + search burst I want to change attribution window from 28d -> 7d for the paid account to get cleaner conversion velocity. This will affect reported CPA, FYI. Can we coordinate creative/pacing + lead routing so ops doesn't lose leads?
Sam: Agree on 7d for test. Will likely show short-term CPA bump but should reveal immediate signal. Who owns the creative refresh?
Anya: Sam can own creative. Idea: swap current carousel with new “feature-focus” CTAs and tighten copy for trial signup. Also, tag this as retarget_test_B in UTMs so we can filter easily.
Sam: I’ll push a 3-card carousel + single-image fallbacks. Proposed copy variants: A) "Try inference at production scale" B) "Lower token costs, faster responses" C) "Book a quick demo". Want to A/B creative vs control.
Leo: Watch audience overlap — if we run search exact-match + retarget at same times, frequency will spike. Recommend freq cap 3/day and exclude converters from search after 1 click in MMP sync.
Maria: I’ll update HubSpot inbound routing. Where should webinar signups go? SDR webinar queue or general demo queue? Also confirm UTM schema.
Anya: Route webinar signups to SDR-webinar-first-touch queue. Demo-intent leads still go to demo queue. UTM we decided: utm_source=google, utm_medium=cpc, utm_campaign=retarget_test_B, utm_content={creative_variant}. Use this exact snippet so ops can filter: ```?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=retarget_test_B&utm_content=variantA```
Jamie: For budget pacing: start with 60% weekday, 40% weekend? I think we should front-load 30% of test budget in first 48h to hit statistical power quicker, then throttle. If attribution window shortens to 7d we need quicker signal.
Sam: I can front-load creative budget. Will set campaign daily caps and a 48h ramp: set bid multiplier +15% for hours 9am-6pm PT first two days.
Leo: Also suggest we add an exclusion rule for recent webinar registrants (last 30d) so we don't waste impressions.
Maria: HubSpot update done — SDR-webinar-first-touch queue = team_webinar_sdr. I added a lead property "paid_campaign_tag" = retarget_test_B. Webhook -> slack #mkt-leads for live monitoring.
Anya: Can someone add a short internal snapshot (daily) to the marketing dashboard with: impressions, clicks, CTR, convs (7d), CPA (7d), creative_variant. Need this for the daily stand.
Sam: I'll export creative_variant dimension into Looker and push a 6am daily row-level alert.
Adops-bot: campaign_scheduler: Created campaign "retarget_test_B" (search + retarget). Start=1745068800 (Mon 09:00 PT), budget=USD 6,000, ramp=48h, freq_cap=3/day, conversion_window=7d.
Anya: Perfect. After first 72h we'll review and decide whether to continue 7d or revert to 28d for longer-funnel evaluation.
Leo: Tagging @growth for FYI on overlap.
Sam: Copy for variantC updated in the draft. Uploading assets now. :rocket:
Maria: Confirmed webhook test — first lead posted to #mkt-leads during dry run.
Anya: Thanks team — will run daily check-ins for the first 5 days. If anyone needs to pause, shout in this thread. :thumbsup:
